verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The staged-rollout cluster is strongest: versioned champion/challenger configuration, variant dimensions, automated evaluation criteria, per-challenger reports, product-owner approval, promotion, independent per-variant monitoring, immediate regression pull, and one-step rollback are all represented at least recognizably.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: Credential security and safety escalation semantics are the largest gaps: the managed vault, per-invocation secret fetch, no local credential storage, repeated-trigger/request handoff conditions, and required handoff context are absent.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board captures the main context-to-reply concept, profile distillation and cold archive at a summary level, and most of the staged-rollout lifecycle. However, it omits several system-defining security, handoff, memory-conflict, and live/cold boundary requirements, while many remaining operational qualifiers are only implied. Weighted credit is 41 of 71, so the board cannot replace the brief as a requirements acceptance record.
